scientific_rules: Prefer varied real observational datasets; synthetic/simulator evidence is diagnostic and labeled.
Preregister hypotheses, panels, seeds, controls, metrics, stops and gates.
Pair rows and RNG roles; fit all preprocessing/vocabulary/target statistics on training only.
Fresh seeds are not fresh datasets; never double-count replay or correlated evidence.
No post-hoc gate changes, exclusions, rescue seeds, objective switches or dataset-specific tuning.
Preserve negative, invalid and contaminated attempts; unexecuted is not a failed experiment.
Require compute-matched controls immediately; parameter matching is separate.
Count teacher/probe/pretraining/retrieval costs; separate training, inference and memory.
Report native task metrics, mean/median, breadth, worst cases, probability quality and concentration.
Average seeds within datasets; explicitly weight datasets and tasks.
Bind raw data/splits/source/checkpoints; replay predictions and recompute metrics for evidence audits.
Separate research from public defaults; no unsupported SOTA/novelty/universal claims.
Keep reserved held-outs closed in development; freeze and separately authorize opening; no retuning afterward.
